items.checks: Read all seven mathematical modules and the full task/reference/contracts. The retraction is constructed from actual injectivity and exactness, then quotient-map functoriality transports the proved split identities. No finite generation or freeness is added to S1. The completed product map has explicit inverse, the row is short exact, every lift has a unique kernel parameter, and changing the actual section gives the required completed difference.

The target is a genuine PowerSeries submodule, with finite surviving support separately at each truncation level. Actual quotient coefficients and finite polynomial truncations are inverse in both directions; all original polynomial scalars and addition are preserved. Scalar closure over PowerSeries is proved directly by divisibility support containment, so the complete-ring action is legitimate rather than merely a claimed coordinate model.

The diagonal and quotient are the actual Finsupp maps. A common exponent bound is used precisely in the n+M support estimate after division. Completed kernel divisibility comes from the original Mth quotient and the killed quotient module. Injectivity, completed surjectivity via the proved native-adic bridge, exactness, and all coordinate lift fibers with a unique restricted-family parameter are derived, including zero exponents and M=0.

Read the complete original quotient-completion counterexample. Both free modules have the actual natural-number basis; the diagonal is injective and its actual quotient gives short exactness. The finite partial-sum representatives form a compatible kernel record. Every supposed completed preimage would force one level-one finite representative to have infinitely many constant coefficients equal to one. No abstract inverse system replaces the given adic filtration.

The same explicit compatible record has a finite original representative at each level. Every proposed single original vector is excluded using an index outside its finite support and its coefficient at the next level. The canonical map's injectivity and actual series coordinates are separately proved.

The ideal-power filtration equals the actual t-power image before the native adic completion theorem is invoked. The constructed linear equivalence preserves quotient reduction, evaluation, original maps and canonical maps. The principal ideal is proved finitely generated; the module is not assumed finitely generated. The actual evaluation kernel is t^n Mhat, and the actual canonical map to the second completion, not a chosen unrelated isomorphism, underlies canonicalDoubleEquiv.
